introduction.p: We will define the probability of an event as the number of ways the event can happen divided by the total number of things that can happen.

statement.p: Suppose you roll two dice (one red and one green). How many total outcomes are there?
Of those outcomes, how many have different numbers on the two dice?

hint.p: How many sequences of two different numbers can you make using the numbers 1 to 6?

statement.p: Combining the two numbers your found above, what is the probability that two dice will show different numbers?
What is the probability that you will get three different numbers when rolling three dice? (Assume the dice are different colors).
